answer_1.quote: We have conducted extensive experiments to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method across diverse tasks, including general-purpose reasoning, mathematical reasoning and open-ended problem solving, covering both pure textual and multimodal (image-text) scenarios.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. (1) Difficulty Estimation. To evaluate the accuracy of our method in the binary classification task of question difficulty estimation, we use ROC-AUC and Macro-F1 score ... (2) Difficulty-Aware Repeated Sampling. We use accuracy and total output length to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed difficulty estimation method when applied to the difficulty-aware repeated sampling.

answer_3.quote: Alternatively, some methods directly employ or fine-tune an auxiliary large language model as judges to assess question difficulty.
